question: Is the existing Iter587 one-graviton Ward contract plus the Iter594 13-term source assembly sufficient, without any new convention, to define the full cubic nonlinear diffeomorphism Ward target?
result: NO: the full nonlinear target is underdetermined by the currently frozen data. The naive replacement of one polarization by h_gauge(mu,nu)=q_mu xi_nu+q_nu xi_mu while leaving the other source legs fixed tests only a linearized gauge-leg contraction. A genuine nonlinear diffeomorphism Ward identity also contains the Lie-derivative action of the gauge parameter on the spectator graviton perturbations and the scalar/source endpoints. No prospectively frozen Fourier-space convention for those nonlinear terms is currently recorded in the authoritative chain.
